mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% for three consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0% for 3 months, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and industrial production indicates broad economic contraction across consumer and business sectors, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle with FEDFUNDS above 4.5%, rising borrowing costs reduce corporate investment and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during monetary tightening cycles, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1300 thousand units for two consecutive months, it indicates a significant residential sector slowdown that reduces consumer demand and corporate revenue growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1300 for 2 months, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 4.0%) signals stagflation, triggering aggressive monetary tightening and reduced corporate profitability that causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and UNRATE > 4.0%, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion phase with GDP growth above 2.0% quarterly, accelerating corporate earnings growth drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
